text_block_list.name: ST-2 (Satie)
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaaahhh!!!

text_block_list.name: ST-2 (Satie)
text_block_list.text:
(This... scenery...
It's just like before I was injured...)

text_block_list.name: ST-2 (Satie)
text_block_list.text:
(Just like when I used to run in races.
—No.)

text_block_list.name: ST-2 (Satie)
text_block_list.text:
(Maybe even beyond that.
To a place far, far ahead...)

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text: Someday... Even reaching that point...

text_block_list.name: ST-2 (Satie)
text_block_list.text:
*pant, pant, pant*... That scenery just now...
This is it...!

text_block_list.name: ST-2 (Satie)
text_block_list.text:
Naturally, there was no leeway to savor it slowly.
It was purely desperate. But...

text_block_list.name: ST-2 (Satie)
text_block_list.text:
Trainer...
U-Uuuu...

text_block_list.name: ST-2 (Satie)
text_block_list.text:
There is no reason for me to cry.
ST-2 cannot—shed tears.

text_block_list.name: ST-2 (Satie)
text_block_list.text:
It does not possess that level of functionality.
However...

text_block_list.name: ST-2 (Satie)
text_block_list.text: I wonder how the mother body is doing.

text_block_list.name: ST-2 (Satie)
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Trainer.
Truly, thank you so much...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Being able to reach our destination today was likely thanks to <chrname> running beside me.
And—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Because I had companions who worked alongside me
on the development up to this point.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: That was magnificent, Doctor.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
"You did it.
You gave it everything you had."

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Yeah... You've shown me what you can really do.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: The Deus Ex Machina is—already right before my eyes.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"Right on schedule. No reason it wouldn't be.
Right?"

text_block_list.name: ST-2 (Satie)
text_block_list.text: Ah, the wind at Tokyo Racecourse is—

text_block_list.name: ST-2 (Satie)
text_block_list.text:
It feels so good...
It really does feel amazing.

text_block_list.name: ST-2 (Satie)
text_block_list.text:
Trainer,
please watch my running one last time.
When we show it off to everyone.

text_block_list.name: ST-2 (Satie)
text_block_list.text: I want you... I want all of you to witness this.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, ST-2 delivered
the best possible result
in the final Upgrade Exam.
